known_execution_risks: This is a post-launch snapshot; it records the running source state but cannot by itself prove that no file changed between launch and capture.

Output names have no run id. This first run began with empty Slide output directories; the hardened evaluator now refuses any existing JSON, so a rerun requires explicit archival rather than silent reuse.
The outer orchestrator does not use set -e around adjudication, so its final success line or exit code is not authoritative; the adjudication JSON and verifier must be inspected directly.
Per-seed evaluation files become visible before the full matrix completes, so strict whole-matrix blinding is procedural rather than technically enforced.
